rationale: The prompt materially requires Cost estimates and infrastructure-specific recommendations. The anchored # Planning and Task Breakdown scopes the source-visible material to Breaks work into ordered tasks. Use when you have a spec or clear requirements and need to break work into implementable tasks. Use when a task feels too large to start, when you need to estimate scope, or when parallel; this is a meaningful neighbouring route, but it does not supply the stated requirement as an independently executable output.
